explication: This repository provides Anikku/Aniyomi extension catalogues: the app invokes source extensions to browse and search remote anime/media providers, retrieve details and episodes, and obtain playable video links. Extensions include standalone sources, shared multi-source implementations, integrations such as Stremio, and reusable network and video-extraction libraries. The README describes catalogue installation and manual APK downloads; sampled source confirms source parsing, addon retrieval, and M3U8 proxy management. Most source implementations were not sampled, so links among individual sources and helpers are intentionally limited.
